item.title: Man Pleads Guilty to Making $8 Million by Creating Music With AI and Using Bots to Drive Zillions of Fake Streams
item.description: A man has plead guilty for creating "hundreds of thousands of songs with AI" and using bots to make $8 million in royalties.

item.title: Sketchy Polymarket Accounts Making Suspicious Bets on Imminent Iran Ceasefire
item.description: A slew of new Polymarket accounts are betting big on an imminent ceasefire between the US and Iran, triggering the alarms.

item.title: Delivery Robot Allegedly Smashes Through Bus Stop Window, Keeps Driving Covered in Broken Glass
item.description: Footage shows a delivery robot showering a sidewalk with shattered glass after allegedly plowing through a bus shelter.

item.title: CEO Confronted Over Using AI to Clone Real People Without Their Consent
item.description: What would you do if it turned out a company was using your name and likeness to profit without your permission?

item.title: NASA Announces Nuclear Mission to Mars by 2028
item.description: NASA is putting Mars back in the crosshairs with a first-of-its-kind nuclear mission it says will launch by the end of 2028.

item.title: No, McDonald's Isn't Deploying Humanoid Robots as Workers in Shanghai
item.description: A video shows a uniformed robotic employee at a McDonald's in Shanghai, China greeting a patron while seemingly taking their order.

item.title: New York Times Accused of Running AI-Generated Article
item.description: People are speculating that an essay published in the New York Times' "Modern Love" was AI-generated. What's definitely real? AI paranoia.

item.title: Trump Administration Would Rather Pay a Billion Dollars Than Build a Single Wind Farm
item.description: The Trump administration announced it would pay French energy giant TotalEnergies nearly a billion dollars to abandon its wind farms.

item.title: NASA Announces Gigantic Armada of Moon Launches to "Build President Trump's Moon Base," Starting Next Year
item.description: NASA firmly recommitted itself to returning astronauts to the Moon, while fleshing out its bold vision for "president Trump's Moon base."

item.title: There's a $10 Billion Problem With Elon Musk's New Chip Factory
item.description: The tech tycoon may be grossly underestimating the cost of his latest hardware venture by tens of billions.

item.title: OpenAI Is Reportedly Killing Its Disastrous Video AI Slop App
item.description: As the Wall Street Journal reports, OpenAI is looking to discontinue its disastrous text-to-video app, Sora, entirely.

item.title: As Mass Layoffs Loom, OpenAI Looks to Double Headcount in Desperate Bid to Catch Up With Anthropic
item.description: OpenAI is looking to grow to around 8,000 staffers, up from around 4,500 today, inside sources told the Financial Times.

item.title: Broken Nvidia CEO Says He Can't Stand AI Slop Either
item.description: In an attempt to reason with outraged gamers, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said he actually hates AI slop, too.

item.title: OpenAI Fumbled Its $1 Billion Deal With Disney
item.description: Disney, which signed a groundbreaking $1 billion deal with OpenAI in December, is pulling out after Sora was canceled.

item.description: Donald Trump's rapidly oscillating statements on the Iran war have been a feeding frenzy for stock market whales.
